# Market Requirements Checklist: Market pulse

**Purpose**: Review the quality of 005's requirements on data integrity, live-source failure,
honest fit and the panel, before and during PR review.
**Created**: 2026-10-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Data integrity

- [ ] CHK001 Is it specified which fields of a live count may be empty for each status (available, no count, unavailable)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Do the requirements say a regional figure's mean and employee count can each be suppressed independently? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, research R3]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "latest published year" for regional pay defined per code, or once for the whole table? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK004 Is a zero history year distinguished from a missing one in both storage and display? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, US3/AC2]
- [ ] CHK005 Do the requirements say what "last full year before the build" means when a build runs in January? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK006 Is each new dataset's licence and credit stated, and consistent with the data dictionary requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK007 Is it specified how ads with no county are counted, so that county counts add up to the total? [Completeness, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the relation between the regional national row and the existing national distribution defined (same figure, or a different measure)? [Consistency, research R3]

## Live-source failure

- [ ] CHK009 Is the live time limit quantified, and consistent with SC-003's 5-second bound? [Measurability, Spec §FR-005, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK010 Is it specified whether an unavailable answer is reused during the reuse period? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the user-visible reasons for "unavailable" enumerated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the reuse period stated as a requirement or only as an assumption? [Traceability, Spec §FR-006, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements defined for a JobSearch answer that is reachable but malformed? [Coverage, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the behaviour defined if the history build is interrupted part-way (resume, or start again)? [Recovery, Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the requirement that the default test run is offline consistent with the new live check? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]

## Honest fit

- [ ] CHK016 Is the honest-fit statement required on every surface that shows market data (REST, the tool, the panel, the memo)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK017 Is "never a reason to choose a code" specified in a testable form for the advisor's memo? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK018 Do the requirements prevent the panel from ranking or sorting codes by demand or pay? [Gap, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK019 Is it stated how a shared count is labelled when two codes of the same group are compared? [Clarity, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK020 Is "must not be drawn as, or compared to, a threshold" specific enough to rule out, for example, colouring the areas above or below the floor? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]

## The panel

- [ ] CHK021 Is it specified how many counties the panel lists before the rest are collapsed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK022 Are loading and error states defined for the panel's own request, apart from the live status? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the history chart's accessible alternative (table view) required, as for the 004 salary chart? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK024 Are the phone-width and accessibility requirements measurable, with the same widths as 004? [Measurability, Spec §FR-020, §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK025 Is it stated whether the panel appears for codes added by the advisor as well as by the user? [Coverage, Gap]

## Performance and dependencies

- [ ] CHK026 Are the reference conditions for SC-002 (cold or warm, network) stated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the dependency on outbound network from the container documented, with its failure behaviour? [Dependency, plan Target Platform]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the assumption that JobSearch stays open without a key backed by a fallback requirement? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the cost of the history fetch (requests, duration) bounded or documented for the cold rebuild? [Gap, research R4]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the correction of the development plan's TAB4185 reference traced to a document that will be updated? [Traceability, research R3]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not change its markers.
